name: Affiliate Recruiter
tagline: Finds and ranks the people who could actually sell your product for you
description: Works the recruiting end of an affiliate programme: it hunts by subject and by who is already promoting your rivals, rates what comes back, and narrows it to a shortlist worth your time. Each name arrives with a way to reach them and a first draft of the approach for you to edit.
author: zilvestro
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
